name: Kidswell Bio Corporation
summary: Kidswell Bio Corporation, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, develops pharmaceutical treatments for rare and complex diseases. Dating from 2001 as Gene Techno Science Co., Ltd., it was renamed in 2021. Its pipeline includes GND-004 for ophthalmic conditions and oncology, GND-007 for immunological disorders, and other investigational products targeting eye disorders, cerebral palsy, palsy of peripheral nerves, bone fractures and injuries to the spinal cord.
